info.title: iProov REST API
info.description:
This is the iProov API documentation guidelines, for simple integration of the iProov system. Note: The base_url that needs to be used is the one in the Service Location. # Introduction To use the iProov service, you will need a valid account on [portal.iproov.com](https://portal.iproov.com), where you will be able to set up your Service Provider API credentials. # Verifier To use Verifier, you need to generate a token with the `/claim/TYPE/token` endpoint, where TYPE is `verify` or `enrol`. Once the claim has finished, you should then make a server to server validation call to the `/claim/TYPE/validate` endpoint to ensure there has been no tampering with the result from the client. # Service Provider API Key and Secret Authentication General operations are secured by the `api_key` and `secret` parameters in the request body. See the individual operation sample request bodies for example usage. The additional schemes below are used for Management and User APIs. # Authentication

oauth2

OAuth2 is used for the Management and User APIs.

Security Scheme Type OAuth2
clientCredentials OAuth Flow Token URL: /{api_key}/access_token
Scopes:
  • user-write - Update the user object
  • user-read - Read the information of users

basicAuth

These can now be obtained via the iPortal - OAuth Username and OAuth password.

Security Scheme Type HTTP
HTTP Authorization Scheme basic

post.summary: Generate a verification token for an existing user to verify with a service provider.
post.description:
Generate a verification token for an existing user to verify with a service provider.

If the given `assurance_type` is invalid or not allowed then the response will be a 403. For example:

- GPA when only LA allowed with that SP key, will be rejected.
- LA when only GPA allowed, will be rejected.
- Unspecified (Default: GPA) and only LA allowed, will be rejected.

Note:

- The returned `token` is valid for 2 mins.

403.description: Invalid Assurance Type, Service Provider Forbidden

post.description:
Validate the verification was successful.

This endpoint can only be called ONCE after a full end to end transaction has been completed. Subsequent calls will return a 400. This end-point will also return 400 if it is called before video streaming finishes.

Note that we strongly recommend you call this endpoint to avoid any man in the middle attacks between the user trying to authenticate and the iProov service (including by the user attempting to log in!).

post.summary: Allows a registered application to obtain an OAuth 2 Bearer Token
post.description:
Allows a registered application to obtain an OAuth 2 Bearer Token, which can be used to make API requests on an application's own behalf, without a user context. Currently only `client_credentials` grant is supported.

Note:

- The OAuth username and password are to be provided via the Authorization header in Basic format. These are distinct to the service provider API key and secret and supplied separately.
- The `access_token` returned expires after 1 hr, or after 50 requests, whichever is earlier.
- The `access_token` needs to be refreshed after it expires.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: The API key of the service provider

grant_type.description: The type of grant being requested by the application

scope.description: Optionally define the scopes being required (omitting grants all allowed scopes)

post.summary: Generate an enrolment token for a new user to enrol with a service provider
post.description:
Generate an enrolment token for a new user to enrol with a service provider.

If the given `assurance_type` is invalid or not allowed then the response will be a 403. For example:

- GPA when only LA allowed with that SP key, will be rejected.
- LA when only GPA allowed, will be rejected.
- Unspecified (Default: GPA) and only LA allowed, will be rejected.

Note:

- The returned `token` is valid for 2 mins.
- For **Capture Enrol**, this token should be used to launch the SDK.
- For **Photo Enrol**, this token should be used for the Enrol Image API below.

403.description: Invalid Assurance Type, Service Provider Forbidden

post.summary: Enrol a user through a trusted photo
post.description:
Enrols a user through a photo that is trusted by the service provider to be a likeness of the user. To call this endpoint you need to perform a previous API call:

 - Firstly get a token that is associated with a user ID.
 - Secondly upload the image with this endpoint. File attachment size limit is 2 MB.

Accepted media types are PNG, JPEG and JP2 images.

Note that due to the security implications of allowing users to enrol with just images this endpoint is restricted on a per service provider basis.

Please speak to Customer Support or email support@iproov.com to enable this. Please note, this request may take up to 2 weeks to action.

api_key.description: The API key of the service provider

secret.description: The API secret for the service provider

rotation.description: The rotation of the image (currently only 0 is supported)

image.description:
The image to enrol the user with.

For reliable enrolment and verification, the photo should show a single, clearly visible face, centered and looking directly at the camera, with the full face inside the frame and some margin from the edges (not cropped). The face should occupy at least 20–50% of the image width, with an inter-eye distance of at least 70px, and the image should be sharp and in focus. Use a standard format (JP2/JPEG/PNG) at a reasonable resolution

token.description: The enrolment token for the user

source.description:
The source of the image (i.e. Electronic ID (`eid`), Optical ID (`oid`) or Selfie (`selfie`))
 - `eid`: If chip based document 
 - `oid`: If ocr based document 
 - `selfie`: If selfie

post.summary: Verify a user through a trusted photo
post.description:
Verify a user through a photo that is trusted by the service provider to be a likeness of the user. Accepted media types are PNG, JPEG and JP2 images. File attachment size limit is 2 MB. Note that due to the security implications of allowing users to verify using just images this endpoint is restricted on a per service provider basis.
 
Please speak to Customer Support or email support@iproov.com to enable this. Please note, this request may take up to 2 weeks to action.

api_key.description: The API key of the service provider

secret.description: The API secret for the service provider

image.description:
The image to verify the user with.

For reliable enrolment and verification, the photo should show a single, clearly visible face, centered and looking directly at the camera, with the full face inside the frame and some margin from the edges (not cropped). The face should occupy at least 20–50% of the image width, with an inter-eye distance of at least 70px, and the image should be sharp and in focus. Use a standard format (JP2/JPEG/PNG) at a reasonable resolution

source.description:
The source of the image (i.e. Electronic ID (`eid`), Optical ID (`oid`) or Selfie (`selfie`))
 - `eid`: If chip based document

post.summary: Validate the enrolment was successful and activate the user
post.description:
Validate the enrolment was successful and activate the user.

This endpoint can only be called ONCE after a full end to end transaction has been completed. Subsequent calls will return a 400. This end-point will also return 400 if it is called before video streaming finishes.

Note that without this endpoint being called the user will not be activated and therefore will be unable to use iProov unless they were enrolled using the photo enrol API.

- `assurance_type`: The given, or implied `assurance_type` is not allowed. With the given SP key if the given `assurance_type` is:
    - GPA when only LA allowed.
    - LA when only GPA allowed.
    - Unspecified (Default: GPA) and only LA allowed.

example: This assurance_type is not enabled for your service provider

frame_available.description: Present and True if there is frame available for returning to the integrator.

frame.description: If `frame_available` is present and True, a base64 encoded PNG format representation of the frame. Is enabled on a per service provider basis in iPortal.

frame_jpeg.description: If `frame_available` is present and True, a base64 encoded representation of the frame in JPEG format. Is enabled on a per service provider basis. Contact support@iproov.com to enable this.

reason.description: The failure reason (enabled on a per service provider basis)

assurance_type.description: Which assurance type was utilized by the transaction

signals.description: An additional summary about the claim. Please speak to Customer Support or email support@iproov.com to enable this. Please note, this request may take up to 2 weeks to action.

anti_spoofing.description: Whether the claim passed antispoofing biometric tests. `null` value means biometric test results aren't available, most likely due to an error.

matching.description: Whether the claim passed face matching. Only relevant when video verifying. `null` value means the face matching result isn't available, most likely due to an error.

multiple_faces.description: A summary of multiple/single face detection results.

found.description: Whether exactly 1 face was found in the validate frame. `null` value means the signle face detection algorithm result isn't available, most likely due to an error.

passed.description: Whether the same face was detected in the video stream. This signal is relevant with LA transactions only at this time. `null` value means the consistent face detection algorithm result isn't available, most likely due to an error.

return_frame_quality.description: An image quality assessment of the returned frame. Only available when `on_validate_return_frame` is enabled.

user_feedback_codes.description: List of user feedback codes, up-to 3 can be returned. These codes are designed to be immediately actionable for end users, helping them to improve their next attempt. These will map to the SDK feedback codes (please note, exact strings will differ according to the corresponding platform naming conventions).

error.description:
- `invalid_key`: Missing or incorrect API Key. Check your API Key is correct:

     1. Log into the iPortal.
     2. Select your Service Provider.
     3. Copy your API key.
     4. Ensure your API Key and Secret are for the correct service provider.
 - `server_error`: Generic iProov error code. If you receive this error code frequently please contact your customer success team or support@iproov.com.

UserResponse.description: Contains a description of the user with User ID, Name, Status of the user, suspension and activated date.

user_id.description: The new identifier for the user

name.description: The name to display to the user when authenticating

ErrorResponse.description: The Error response contains an error constant which can be used to split up responses and can be converted to translatable error messages. The error description returns a more descriptive error response that is largely designed for developers to get detailed information for failures.

ClientErrorResponse.description: Missing data in the request, or the state of the requested entity object is such that the operation could not succeed.

error.description:
- `invalid_agent`: **DEPRECATED**.
 - `invalid_user_id`: Malformed, illegal characters in the user_id, missing, or non-existent user_id given.
   - Regex: `[a-zA-Z0-9'\+_@\.-]{1,256}`.

 - `invalid_token`: An invalid token was provided in the body.
   - Ensure the correct claim token is passed from the POST /claim/enrol/token or POST /claim/verify/token calls.
   - Ensure the token is incorrectly reused. For an Enrol Capture call, once an image has been **registered** against a token, it cannot be called again.
   - Attempted to validate a claim token that was previously validated.
   - Attempted to validate a claim token before video imagery finished streaming.

 - `invalid_validation`: The username does not match the username associated with the claim token.
   - Ensure the correct `user_id` is used.

 - `invalid_reason`: Malformed, illegal characters in `reason` parameter.
   - Regex: `^[a-zA-Z0-9_.:=()'\'\"/\s]{1,800}$`.

 - `no_face_found`: No face found in enrolment image. Please try again with a photo with a face in it.
 - `invalid_grant`: Malformed, or missing `grant_type`. Correct the `grant_type` field.
   - Regex: `^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]{0,30}$`.

 - `invalid_request`: Malformed, or invalid IPv4 address given in `ip` field, or missing `grant_type` parameter.
 - `invalid_client`: Invalid, or missing basicAuth credentials for the given API key/Service Provider when requesting
   OAuth `access_token`. Provide the correct credentials/API key - defined within your Service Provider. A key rotation
   may have occurred.
 - `invalid_scope`: Malformed `scope` parameter in request.
   - Regex: `^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]{0,100}$`.

 - `unsupported_grant_type`: The request's `grant_type` parameter value is not `client_credentials`.
 - `missing_data`: Missing `resource`, `reason` or `token` parameter/value in request body.
 - `no_user`: The given `user_id` or username doesn't exist.
 - `inactive_user`: User is in the wrong state (should have an Active state). Ensure the user is not suspected (User management API).
 - `invalid_enrol_image`: Missing image attachment in multipart form data. Ensure the image is appended to the multipart form body correctly.
 - `invalid_source`: The `source` request parameter value must be one of `oid`, `eid` or `selfie`.
 - `already_enrolled`: The given username or `user_id` has already enrolled. Did you mean to conduct a verify transaction?
   If a re-enrol is required, then either pass a new user_id or use the User Management API to delete the user and
   request a new enrol claim token.
 - `invalid_key`: Missing or incorrect API Key. Check your API Key is correct:
   1. Log into the iPortal.
   2. Select your Service Provider.
   3. Copy your API key.
   4. Ensure your API Key and Secret are for the correct service provider

InvalidCredentialErrorResponse.description: One of: invalid OAuth token, expired OAuth token, invalid credentials, API Key and/or Secret is missing, malformed, or incorrect.

error.description:
- `invalid_key`: Missing or incorrect API Key. Check your API Key is correct:
   1. Log into the iPortal.
   2. Select your Service Provider.
   3. Copy your API key.
   4. Ensure your API Key and Secret are for the correct service provider
 - `invalid_oauth`: Missing OAuth `access_token`.
   - Call POST /{api_key}/access_token to obtain a new OAuth Access token. Access tokens expire after 1 hr or 50 requests.
 - `invalid_token`: Invalid OAuth `access_token`.
   - Call POST /{api_key}/access_token to obtain a new OAuth Access token. Access tokens expire after 1 hr or 50 requests.
 - `token_quota_exceeded`: 50/50 Oauth user requests used.
   - Call POST /{api_key}/access_token to obtain a new OAuth Access token. Access tokens expire after 1 hr or 50 requests.
